name: sapper-v2
description: Contest kit that coordinates several coding assistants around a shared engagement graph, with a web board
seenIn: No public report of use in an attack. Covered from its source code and scan data

indicators.context: HTML title of the sapper-v2 board (sapper view --serve, plain HTTP, no login, 127.0.0.1:8765 by default) and of the sapper-graph.html snapshot. The em dash is U+2014. An exposed board shows an engagement's targets, credentials and flags
indicators.source: ThreatDefence review of the sapper-v2 source code

indicators.context: Path of the graph JSON on the sapper-v2 board, /__sapper_graph__/<24 hex>.json, polled every 2 seconds by the open board page. The token is printed in the page at /, so anyone who loads the page can read the graph
indicators.source: ThreatDefence review of the sapper-v2 source code

indicators.context: Default port of the sapper-v2 board (sapper view --serve --port). Many other services use it; the one exposed board seen in November 2026 used 2333. Context only Nebula's headless core defaults to 8765 (BerylliumSec/nebula).
indicators.source: ThreatDefence review of the sapper-v2 source code
